This v6 does not reuse the v5 version number.' In v6 that was accurate; in v7 it is stale, and it is exactly the second limb of CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1 — a predecessor role carrying a self-referential version claim that no longer matches the artifact. Three measurements close the historical-reading defence. This artifact's own predecessorV3 and predecessorV4 roles both end 'Not this artifact's version number', the neutral form that exists to stop this going stale. Its predecessorV6 role was written fresh as 'This v7 does not reuse the v6 version number', so the newest role was updated and the older one was not. And permission-leftover-join.v7, same document class and same successor step, reviewed one dispatch ago, rewrote this exact sentence in its own predecessorV5 role from 'This v6…' to 'Not this artifact's version number'. It matters because findingDisposition records CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1 as ACCEPTED and lands names it, so the artifact claims to have landed a finding while carrying one instance of the defect that finding charged. The other limbs do hold — identity triple consistent at v7/7, every predecessorVn key pointing at vn — so the disposition is overstated by one sentence rather than false, and the repair is that sentence alone. Everything else is correct and some of it matters beyond this subject. summary.leftoverDesign is byte-identical to v6's eight, which is the set I resolved the shortfall tests against at g21-leftover-join.v2 and g12-leftover-join.v2 today; v7 preserving it leaves those rulings intact. Thirty obligations reconcile against thirty summary entries with zero inconsistencies and exactly eight true. The register checks the dispatch names all pass at source: the DR-114 status cell begins OPEN, DR-G12's owner cell is 'Operability + security' and DR-G21's is 'Supervisor + protocol + operability', both byte-identical to liveGateOwners, which has those two keys and no third. G31 and G32 are not live and I verified that in file 08 rather than from the artifact — zero occurrences of either, no rows — while both G32 obligations sit at leftoverDesign false as candidates stating 'not recordable until G31 is live'. No ride is forced onto G09: the artifact quotes v8's 'DR-G09 fixture execution / DR-114 fixture-corpus execution' verbatim, which I confirmed in v8, and then declines the implication because G09's live claim owns permission truth rather than actor-join fixture execution. All eleven cited reviews are ACCEPT 0/0, the three G32 artifacts included. Zero D-006 occurrences, no D9 code minted, FC-C1 still open and unrecorded, CA-2 still-routed, CA-1 IN_PROCESS refused.
